Information

[edit]

Format

[edit]
  • Group Stage: March 1st - 24th
    • Round robin group
    • Top 4 teams advance to Seeding Decider Matches
    • Next 4 teams advance to Last Chance Qualifier
    • Bottom team is eliminated
  • Seeding Decider Matches: March 29th - 31st
    • Round robin group
    • All 4 teams advance to Playoffs
    • Top 2 teams receive a first-round bye
  • Last Chance Qualifier: March 28th - 31st
    • Double elimination bracket
    • Top 2 teams advance to Playoffs
  • Playoffs: April 5th - 7th
    • Single elimination bracket
    • Top 3 teams advance to Stage 1 Main Event
    • Fourth place team advances to Wild Card

properties.*: Overwatch Champions Series 2024 - Korea Stage 1 is an offline Korean OW2 tournament organized by Blizzard Entertainment and WDG. This A-Tier tournament took place from Mar 01 to Apr 07 2024 featuring 9 teams competing over a total prize pool of $45000 USD.
